messages:
zara: Heads-up: PartnerNimbus reported that a batch of Azure Marketplace rows (2026-03-25) imported without their downstream withholding_tax flag, so withholding wasn't applied on certain downstream invoices.
michael-fin: That's a tax exposure risk — do we have examples showing the missing flag vs expected?
partner-ops: They attached their export. Example row:
```
InvoiceId,Date,BuyerReference,DownstreamId,NetAmount,withholding_tax
inv-309,2026-03-25,nimbus-az-111,nimbus-cust-9,1000.00,{MISSING}
inv-310,2026-03-25,nimbus-az-111,nimbus-cust-10,500.00,false
```
zara: In this case cust-9 should've had withholding_tax=true and we should have deducted 10% at invoice time.
eng-data: Where does withholding_tax get applied? billing-core during invoice build. It looks up downstream attributes from buyer_to_customer + tax_attributes.
partner-ops: Nimbus says their downstream feed renamed the field from `withholding_tax` -> `tax_withhold` on 2026-03-25 accidentally.
michael-fin: Finance immediate ask: produce reconciliation CSV with columns: invoice_id, downstream_id, invoiced_withhold, expected_withhold, delta_amount, action_reco. We'll use that to issue corrective credit/debit memos.
eng-data: Quick mitigation: add tolerant parser to accept both `withholding_tax` and `tax_withhold` in partner feeds and add a validation alert when required tax fields are missing. ETA for patch: 36hrs.
partner-ops: Nimbus will re-export corrected file for 2026-03-25 and provide mapping for Mar 20-25 in case of wider drift. They also approved provisional settlement to cover estimated differences.
billing-bot: audit: ticket-8599 created; nimbus_mapping_mar25.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-8599/ at 2026-03-26T10:12:05Z
michael-fin: Finance will hold provisional memos until we receive partner re-export. Please attach the reconciliation CSV to BILL-8599 when ready.
zara: Leaving thread open until re-export processed and credits posted. Thanks all.
